goal: Store event-level replay records without breaking current performance results.
must_implement: Raw sidecar attachment, event schema validation, per-event trace IDs, and environment/document metadata.
can_reuse: testInfo.attach('results'), raw reporter output, Metrics tracing, and existing R derived-data pipeline.
acceptance_gate: A replay run writes raw per-event records plus curated summaries, and current q50 reporter output remains unchanged.
claim_boundary: Allows synthetic replay development only; no product workload claim.

goal: Replay deterministic synthetic event manifests across at least ordinary text, shortcut/paste, selection, and block-operation strata.
must_implement: Manifest-driven executor, complete-keypress text path, pressKeys/clipboard path, click/selection path, block action path, and recorded-gap scheduling.
can_reuse: post-editor performance setup, PerfUtils fixture loading, pressKeys, editor helpers, and Metrics tracing.
acceptance_gate: Each stratum produces source spans, visual or behavior endpoints, and retained per-event samples.
claim_boundary: Can test harness semantics and source attribution on synthetic strata; still not human/plugin representative.

goal: Reject latency samples that do not reproduce the intended editor state.
must_implement: Text/content hash assertions, selection/focus assertions, visible-list/appender assertions, structural hash assertions, and per-stratum failure reporting.
can_reuse: existing editor content/selection helpers and Playwright locators.
acceptance_gate: Every replayed event has a pass/fail assertion record; failed events are excluded from latency claims and reported separately.
claim_boundary: Can evaluate low-risk patches only within covered strata.

goal: Collect redacted real or plugin-heavy editing histories and replay them by stratum.
must_implement: Opt-in recorder, redaction/hashing, plugin/theme/session metadata, event gaps/hold/composition fields, source/visual IDs, and fixture materialization.
can_reuse: one-off typing-delay instrumentation patterns, raw sidecar files, and existing fixture loaders.
acceptance_gate: At least ordinary text, correction/backspace, selection/navigation, paste/transform, long-idle return, and plugin side-effect strata have recorded samples and behavior assertions.
claim_boundary: Only then can owner rankings support product-latency claims beyond the fixed-x stressor.
